detail.longDescription: Royal Botanic Gardens Kew: Kew launches global seed platform to tackle native seed bottleneck holding back nature restoration. “Today, the Royal Botanic Gardens, Kew (RBG Kew) launches the Seed Portal for Online Data (SeedPOD), a new open-access platform designed to tackle bottlenecks affecting global ecological restoration, by making native seed collections and the knowledge needed to grow […] https://rbfirehose.com/2026/10/30/royal-botanic-gardens-kew-kew-launches-global-seed-platform-to-tackle-native-seed-bottleneck-holding-back-nature-restoration/
